meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按依赖顺序分阶段推进多步骤任务,出错可重试或修改后继续。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要让多个互有先后依赖的任务按序自动推进。
copy.tagline_en: Run dependent subtasks in phases, with retry and repair on failure.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to push groups of ordered tasks automatically.

howto.what: 当任务之间有先后依赖时,Claude 会把它们定义成一张任务图(DAG),让要等上游先完成的子任务按批并行执行;某个节点失败时可以只重试它、改它的指令或给它发消息,不用重跑整张图。
howto.when: 当你说出 “mass-ulw”、要求一张任务依赖图,或需要分批展开且部分任务必须等别的任务先完成时触发。一次运行只覆盖一个阶段。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 帮我做一张任务图:先审计、再重写、最后验证
say.note: Claude 会定义这张 DAG 并启动运行

say.text: 重试 run_stub_1 里的 lint 节点,并改掉它的指令
say.note: 只重跑该节点,已完成的节点结果保留

say.text: 给正在跑的那个节点发条消息,让它跳过 vendored 目录
say.note: send 会把消息投递给该节点的子代理

howto.what_en: When tasks have real ordering dependencies, Claude defines a task graph (DAG) and runs its nodes in parallel waves, one run per phase; a failed node can be retried, re-instructed, or steered without redoing the graph.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “mass-ulw”, ask for a task dependency graph, or need fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others. One run covers a single phase.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to build a task graph: audit first, rewrite next, verify last
say_en.note: Claude defines the DAG and starts the run

say_en.text: Retry the lint node in run_stub_1 and edit its instruction
say_en.note: Only that node re-runs; finished nodes keep results

say_en.text: Send the running node a message to skip the vendored dir
say_en.note: send steers that node's child in place
